newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN TOSS, PUT AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN TOSS, PUT AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.

text.p: England captain Michael Atherton won the toss and put Australia in to bat in the third and final one-day international at Lord's on Sunday.
Out-of-form Australian skipper Mark Taylor left himself out and was replaced as opener by Matthew Elliott, with Steve Waugh taking over the leadership.
The touring team's only other change from the side beaten by six wickets at The Oval on Saturday was the inclusion of Justin Langer in the middle order for Michael Slater.

England brought in batsman John Crawley, all-rounder Ben Hollioake, brother of team mate Adam, and pace bowler Chris Silverwood for their first appearances of the series, in which the home country have a winning 2-0 lead.
England - Michael Atherton (captain), Alec Stewart, Ben Hollioake, John Crawley, Graham Thorpe, Graham Lloyd, Adam Hollioake, Mark Ealham, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Chris Silverwood.
Australia - Mark Waugh, Matthew Elliott, Steve Waugh (captain), Michael Bevan, Justin Langer, Adam Gilchrist, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Mike Kasprowicz, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
